description: Everything an EVM wallet holds across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon in one call: native coin and every ERC-20 balance priced in USD, sorted by value, with per-chain and overall totals and the top 10 holdings. Spam and unpriced tokens are counted, not listed. Optional chains limits which networks are read. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

chains.description: Comma-separated subset of base, eth, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default all)

name: wallet_balances
